natalie: PTAL on PR #4321 — I addressed the review comments, removed the unused proto fields, added a focused unit test for the edge case, and updated the changelog. PTAL when you have a minute.
sam: thanks — looking now. did you run the flaky test a few times locally?
natalie: yeah; ran it 10x, all green. small snippet I used: `for i in {1..10}; do pytest tests/test_retry.py::test_timeout_edge; done`
choi: CI looks green on all jobs so far (just the long-run flaky job queued). ci-bot: build/4321 — all checks passed except e2e-flaky which is queued.
mike: quick note: can you also bump the proto minor version so consumers pick up the removed field? otherwise they might deserialize stale messages.
natalie: good catch — bumped to v1.3.1 and pushed. changelog entry: "proto: remove unused field X; bump to v1.3.1"
sam: LGTM for code. one nit about a log message but non-blocking.
choi: PTAL granted — left a small comment but not blocking.
mike: approve from me once CI finishes.
sam: approving now. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: build/4321 — e2e-flaky finished: flaky-job passed.
natalie: thanks all — I'll queue this for the next merge window (today 16:00 PT). If anyone wants a quick look before then, ping me.
choi: ack, thanks for the follow-up.
natalie: also, replying here in case product/eng wants to know — no behavior changes expected, just cleanup and test hardening.
sam: cool, thanks.
mike: thanks — LGTM.
